data.one_liner: A Flutter widget to edit JSON objects via a user-friendly tree or text editor.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable widget for editing JSON data in either a tree view or a text editor view. It supports creating, deleting, and modifying keys and values, as well as searching and expanding nested objects.
use_when: You need to let users view or edit JSON objects directly inside a Flutter application.
You want both a structured tree view and a raw text view for editing JSON data.
avoid_when: You are looking for code generation tools to map JSON to immutable Dart classes.
You need complex data persistence or database management.
strengths: Supports both tree and text editors for JSON.
Highly customizable with options to enable or disable key/value editing and more options.
Includes built-in search functionality and configurable expanded objects.
weaknesses: Limited to what is supported by the widget properties; highly specialized custom JSON schema validation might not be built-in.
